one_line: An interactive guide classifying male eye shapes using Cristiano Ronaldo as a reference, ending with a shareable summary grid.

hook.what_happens: Cristiano Ronaldo's face is shown next to a scrolling selector of eye types under the question 'Which type are you?'.
hook.why_it_works: Uses a globally recognized celebrity and personal relevance to immediately hook the viewer's curiosity.

shots.description: Split screen showing Cristiano Ronaldo on the left and a vertical scrolling list of 3D eye models on the right.
A 3x4 grid displaying all 10 eye types with their respective labels for the viewer to screenshot.

devices.name: scrolling selector
devices.what_it_is: A vertical carousel of 3D eye models.

devices.name: academic citation overlay
devices.what_it_is: A text block citing a scientific study on facial aesthetics.
devices.used_for: Adding authority and scientific credibility to the claims.

devices.name: screenshot call-to-action
devices.what_it_is: Onscreen text prompting the user to 'SCREENSHOT & SAVE'.

narrative_arc: Introduce the core question using a famous face.
Scroll through various eye classifications with descriptive traits.
Introduce scientific backing to validate the classifications.
Present a final summary grid encouraging user saving and sharing.

cta.what: Screenshot and save the eye type grid to find your type.

what_makes_it_work: Leverages celebrity association to capture immediate attention.
Interactive 'self-diagnosis' format drives high viewer retention.
Scientific citation adds credibility to the aesthetic claims.

animations.name: Stepped Vertical Scroll
animations.what_moves: A vertical stack of eye-type cards on the right side of the frame.
animations.layered_with: The static portrait of Cristiano Ronaldo on the left.
animations.purpose: Sequentially showcases different eye shapes to engage the viewer in self-identification.
animations.reusable_as: Displaying a list of product features, options, or steps in a process.
animations.would_need_building: A vertical stepped carousel component that transitions cards upward with a pause on each.

animations.name: Scientific Text Reveal
animations.what_moves: The 'Attractive male faces' header and academic citation text block.
animations.layered_with: The ongoing vertical scroll of eye types.
animations.purpose: Introduces scientific credibility and context to the facial analysis.
animations.reusable_as: Revealing footnotes, technical specifications, or source citations.

animations.name: Staggered Grid Pop-In
animations.what_moves: A 3x4 grid of eye-type cards on the final summary screen.
animations.purpose: Presents all options simultaneously for a final summary and shareable moment.
animations.reusable_as: Displaying a catalog of products, features, or plan options at the end of an ad.
animations.would_need_building: A grid layout component that staggers the entry of its child elements using a scale-up animation.

signature_moves: Staggered grid pop-ins for summary screens
animation_language_summary.how_things_enter: Cards scroll vertically into view; text and grid elements fade or scale up in place.
animation_language_summary.how_things_leave: Elements are replaced by a full-screen transition to the final grid layout.
animation_language_summary.how_scenes_change: A clean cut from the split-screen comparison to the full-screen grid summary.
animation_language_summary.what_stays_still: The main portrait of Cristiano Ronaldo remains static on the left during the comparison phase.
animation_language_summary.rhythm: Constant and steady during the comparison phase, transitioning to a rapid, energetic burst of grid entries at the end.

what_we_should_steal: The stepped vertical card scroll for engaging, interactive-feeling option selection.
The staggered grid pop-in for clean, satisfying summary screens.
